team.title: Meet the team
team.intro: Everyone on the team has one job and does it all day. You only talk to Wkil.

members.name: Wkil
members.role: You talk to it in one chat. It understands your request, gives it to whoever on the team can do it, checks the work and comes back with the result.

members.name: Customer service agent
members.role: Answers your customers on WhatsApp, Messenger, site chat and Facebook comments, from what it knows about your business. When it doesn't know, it passes the conversation to you.
members.spares: Answering "how much?" in the middle of the night.

members.name: WhatsApp messages agent
members.role: Sends your customers WhatsApp messages at the right moment with any utility template Meta has approved, such as an order confirmation, a shipping update or a reminder. When a message has buttons, it tells you what each customer answered.
members.spares: Calling every customer to confirm or remind them.

members.name: Content agent
members.role: Plans your posts, writes them, prepares their images, and publishes or schedules them on your Facebook Page.
members.spares: A quiet Page because there's no time to write.

members.name: Knowledge agent
members.role: Learns your business from your website, your files and your customers' questions, and the rest of the team answers from it.
members.spares: Repeating the same information every time.

members.name: Reports agent
members.role: Tells you how many conversations were answered, what is waiting for you, and the average reply time.
members.spares: Digging through screens to see how work is going.

members.name: Hire your own agent
members.role: Have a job that isn't on the list? Hire an agent for it and tell it what to do, and Wkil adds it to your team.
members.spares: The recurring job nobody has time for.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.intro: All plans are in Egyptian pounds. Every plan has two allowances: message credits for what the team sends your customers, and time with Wkil for your own tasks.
pricing.metaFees: WhatsApp fees aren't part of the plan price. You pay them to Meta directly, with no markup from Wkil: on order confirmation messages, and on WhatsApp replies after the first 1,000 messages a month per number. The thank-you message after a customer taps Confirm or Cancel counts as a reply. Messenger and site chat carry no Meta fees.
notes: Message credits pay for what the team sends your customers: a reply uses 4 credits and an order confirmation uses 1. Thank-you messages after a button tap, handover notices and anything your staff send don't use credits.
Credits renew every month and don't carry over.

Wkil has a limit every 5 hours and a weekly limit, shared by everyone on your account. You always see how much is left and when it renews. Task numbers are approximate: a quick question uses less than a full content plan.
To protect your number from WhatsApp restrictions, confirmations go to a limited number of new customers each day. The rest wait and go out as soon as the limit allows.

trial.label: Try first
trial.text: Growth free for 14 days, with 3,000 message credits. Meta's message fees are yours, and afterwards you pick your plan or stay on Free.

accordions.question: Ran out of message credits?
accordions.answer: Add 4,000 credits for EGP 499 (1,000 replies or 4,000 confirmations), valid for 90 days, or move up a plan. Until then, new conversations go to your inbox with a short note to the customer, and order confirmations keep going out.

accordions.question: Reached Wkil's limit?
accordions.answer: Wait until the time shown, or move up a plan. Replies to your customers and order confirmations are never affected.

accordions.question: Another WhatsApp number?
accordions.answer: Add one for EGP 299 a month: one extra number on Growth, up to 3 numbers on Scale.

accordions.question: An agency, more than 3 numbers, or more than 40,000 credits a month?
accordions.answer: A custom plan starts at EGP 7,999 a month, invoiced by bank transfer.

items.question: Does the team work on its own?
items.answer: Yes. Customer replies and order confirmation run all day with nothing for you to do. When you ask Wkil to publish a post or send a message in your name, it shows you what it will do first.

items.question: What if someone on the team can't answer a customer?
items.answer: It stops, and the conversation moves to your inbox with its type: sales, support or complaint. You can reply yourself in any conversation.

items.question: Does the team work on Instagram?
items.answer: No. The team works on WhatsApp, Messenger, site chat and Facebook comments, and publishes to Facebook Pages.

items.question: Can my number stay on the WhatsApp Business app?
items.answer: Yes, if you like. The number stays on the app and the team replies alongside you, or you can use a dedicated number.

items.question: My store isn't on EasyOrders?
items.answer: If your store can send orders to a webhook, you can connect it. If your system has an API, the team can look up a price or an order status from it on the Growth plan. Both need a technical person.
